newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares fail to resume trade.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares fail to resume trade.

text.p: Trading in shares of Italian information technology group Olivetti failed to resume after the stock was suspended earlier on Wednesday after rising to hit a 10 percent trading limit.
The stock market council said the stock would attempt to resume trade at 1310 GMT after failing to do so at 1200 GMT.
Olivetti made a day's high of 511.5 lire earlier on Wednesday, nearly 10 percent up on the day, after plummeting in recent days to forge an all-time low on Tuesday at 465 lire.

The stock repeatedly triggered automatic suspension on Tuesday by hitting the floor of its trading range as players sold ahead of an Olivetti statement on its finances which was eventually released on Wednesday morning.
The statement, which had been demanded by stock market regulator Consob, left analysts none the wiser about the group's financial state.
Olivetti's board holds a meeting at 1600 GMT later on Wednesday and newspapers speculated there would be changes to the board, with the possible ousting of chief executive Francesco Caio.
